mechanism: Furosemide can cause hypokalemia and hyponatremia which may potentiate propylthiouracil-induced agranulocytosis risk; electrolyte abnormalities also increase cardiac arrhythmia susceptibility in hyperthyroid patients.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (K+, Na+) regularly, maintain adequate potassium levels, and monitor CBC during concurrent use; consider potassium-sparing alternative or potassium supplementation if furosemide is necessary.
